reviews.scope: AIMuon fixed-v1 Algorithm1 and AppendixC.2 versus independent local implementation
reviews.finding: The initial epsilon1e-8 differed from paper1e-12 at small gradient magnitudes; corrected before source freeze and actual CPU/CUDA runs. Added a literal small-gradient equation regression. BF16 NS5, update order, independent transforms and decoupled decay were checked.

reviews.scope: SPOT fixed-v2 Algorithm1/Eq2 and pinned author metrics.py
reviews.finding: Reviewed multi-slot absorption without a break, K-closing, original prediction-index semantic matrices and occupied-slot TP. Reviewer reports1000 randomized finite-trace comparisons without differences; this is scorer checking, not benchmark capability. Added closed/open-slot, wrong-semantics and zero-credit controls.
reviews.boundary: At a zero score from floating underflow and threshold0, the local scorer follows the paper's positive-T condition rather than treating a zero-credit response as occupying a slot. No full-domain bit-identical upstream claim.

reviews.scope: Acting-to-Learning and R2 fixed-paper formulas and agent modules
reviews.finding: Checked optimizer-aware gradient features, global/quota scheduling, VFD/RA-GRPO equations, no gold-reading path and explicit external rollout/gradient inputs. Numeric overflow checks and finite metrics are retained. No model-policy training is claimed.

Checked positive/negative pairing, centered leading-PC ordering, shared stratified quantiles, complete sparse chain rule, full prefix-softmax score gradients and the symmetry exception. Neither sparse-output sanity nor sampled-logit-only arithmetic is advertised as full policy-gradient capability.

reviews.scope: DISCO statistical contract and all nine cost dispositions
reviews.finding: Binary unboosted e-process API exposes only coarsened selector views, explicitly assumes valid query-invariant memoryless p-values and calculates finite-law bounds by exact enumeration, not uncorrected Monte Carlo. Full three-bin/boosted LLM discovery remains unimplemented. CTRL/CoEvoBench are review-only, not fake metrics or CPU substitutes for GPU systems.
